description: ANAVANDI offline transit dataset — Central Kerala focus

sources.name: KochiTransport GTFS (Jungle Bus / OSM)
sources.notes: Open GTFS feed for Kochi metro area. Used for stop coordinate reference and route structure.

sources.name: kbuses.in KSRTC Schedules
sources.notes: KSRTC route timings and stop sequences scraped from public schedule pages.

sources.name: Kerala Private Bus Timing (RTI Dataset)
sources.notes: RTI-sourced private bus schedules in JSON. 3+ years old — used as reference, not ground truth.

sources.name: Manually Curated Stops & Aliases
sources.notes: Hand-verified stop coordinates, multilingual names, and tourist alias mappings.

limitations: Private bus schedules may be outdated (RTI data from 2023)
Fare estimates use stage-based formula when exact fare matrix is unavailable
Stop coordinates are approximate for stops without GTFS data
Coverage limited to Central Kerala districts
